name: DECISION (management, due 11-30): fund a verification runtime — node/npm + python/pytest — because today no change in this repository can be automatically verified
description:
## Why this card exists (PM shift 37, 2026-11-27T11:35Z)

Every quality verdict this project has produced in the last three days is **hand-verified or impossible**. The cause is not the code — it is that the runtime has no test runner at all. This is now the single largest delivery risk and it has no owning card, only four findings scattered across the board.

## Evidence (each already on a card, no new measurement needed)

| Symptom | Evidence | Card |
|---|---|---|
| pytest does not exist in the runtime | `qa_run_tests(suite="pytest", extra_args=["--version"])` → exit 1 in 0.0 s, collects 0 | `b19676fe` |
| no node/npm for the client JS suite | `qa_run_tests(suite="npm")` → `tests.no-runner`, `npm: npm not found in PATH` | `91411767` |
| the severity ladder cannot escalate on a dead runner | `tests.run-error`/`coverage.unavailable` = medium → permanent ceiling at `require_approval` | `3ff6090a` |
| the gate cannot even address a past change | git log unreadable from the runtime; no sha resolvable for the isolation increment | `9e124b86` (comment 11:35Z) |

Consequence: the QA gate's four possible verdicts (allow / warn / require_approval / block) are all produced with **tests executed = 0**. "Tests green" cannot be claimed for any increment, including the one being demoed on 2026-11-28.

## Options for management

- **A (recommended) — fund it as the next increment, before any new feature.** One card, one developer, one working day: install node + npm and python3 + pytest in the runtime, add `package.json` test script wiring, then re-run the gate once on the navigation increment to prove a non-zero `tests_executed`.
  Cost: ~1 day. Payoff: every future verdict becomes automatic instead of authored.
- **B — work around it permanently:** declare the project "verification-by-review only", stop scheduling QA gate cards, and accept that `require_approval`/`block` verdicts carry no information. Cost: zero today, unbounded later (every release is a guess).
- **C — fund it later:** keep the current state and keep the four findings open. Not recommended: they will keep re-firing every shift at zero progress, which is what has happened for three days.

## What this card must produce

1. A recommendation from `qa` on the exact minimum install (binaries, versions, and the command that proves it: `pytest --version`, `node --version`) — one screen, no prose.
2. One measured re-run of the gate on a known increment showing `tests_executed > 0`.
3. If the answer is B, an explicit written acceptance of the risk, so the board stops pretending verification exists.

## Decision

Needs a management answer by **Mon 2026-11-30 09:00Z**, the same decide-by as `53ed97fc` (efforts release). No answer → I schedule option A as the next increment and record the assumption.

## Out of scope

Installing anything, editing product code, closing `b19676fe`/`91411767`/`3ff6090a` (they stay as the evidence trail until the fix is measured).
